title: Holding Several Equipment Placements Under Durable Medical Equipment Rentals
content:
**Term.** A patient may hold any number of Durable Medical Equipment Rentals placements of different items, subject to the rule on identical items (one ordered, rented or owned placement per HCPCS code at a time). There is no maximum number of placements per patient.

A placement is one item of durable medical equipment placed with one patient by one supplier, classed by its TRICARE DMEPOS payment class.

## The term in parts

| Question | Answer under this term |
|---|---|
| Is there a cap on how many placements one patient holds? | No; no maximum number of placements per patient is set. |
| Do the placements have to be of different items? | Yes; the term covers placements of different items. |
| What limits a second placement of the same item? | The rule on identical items, to which this term is subject. |

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical patient holds an oxygen concentrator in rental (code E1390), a hospital bed in rental (code E0250) and an owned walker (code E0130). Three different items are held at once, and this term sets no number beyond which a further placement of a different item is refused.
